plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Context-driven development framework. Measure twice, code once.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Shows context window fill (tokens and %) and how much the last turn added, on the line under the prompt

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Counts down the prompt cache's TTL on the line under the prompt, with a toast before it expires

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Shows the 5-hour and weekly rate-limit windows with reset countdowns, on the line under the prompt

plugins.name: after-reset
plugins.description: /after-reset <prompt> sends a prompt once your usage limit resets, or at a time you name
